claims: Texas A&M baseball defeated Texas 9-8 in the series opener on Friday, April 10, 2026, at Blue Bell Park.
Reliever Clayton Freshcorn closed out the game in the ninth inning for the Aggies.
Texas A&M baseball (the Aggies) lost to Texas State 9-8 on April 7.
The game against Texas State was a midweek game.
The next game in the Texas A&M vs. Texas series is at Blue Bell Park in College Station.
